reply.emotion: cozy and domestic, getting ready to put shoes on for the day
notes: Meia means both 'sock' and 'half' (as a shortened form of metade). Context always makes it clear which one is meant.

senses.definition: Soft piece of clothing worn on the foot inside a shoe.

examples.text: Preciso colocar uma meia limpa antes de calçar o tênis.
examples.translation: I need to put on a clean sock before putting on my sneakers.
examples.emotion: practical and unhurried, getting dressed in the morning

senses.definition: One of two equal parts of a whole; a half.

examples.text: Comprei meia melancia na feira hoje.
examples.translation: I bought half a watermelon at the market today.
examples.emotion: casual and matter-of-fact, talking about everyday grocery shopping

definitions: Soft piece of clothing worn on the foot inside a shoe.
